analysis: Retain every scan and each scan-specific affine; do not pool participant coordinate frames.
Report each component centroid in source IJK and RAS+ millimetres, component occupancy, and fraction of label voxels.
Order components by RAS+ X for description only; do not claim named muscle or clinical laterality from that ordering.

evidence_boundary: Automatic external CT Psoas source-mask component geometry only; no named muscle identity, clinical segmentation validation, physical volume, Numi subject binding, or mechanics.
experimental_unit: one source scan and all 26-connected components of its aggregate Psoas label
predictions: The full-cohort component count distribution reproduces the retained census: 29 scans have two components and scan 024 has three.

question: Across the 30 external CT Psoas masks, how are 26-connected components distributed spatially, and what fraction of labelled voxels does any extra component occupy?
stop_rule: Stop at the first archive, member hash, shape, affine, voxel-count, or source-code identity failure; retain all scan rows and do not filter participants.
validity_checks: The whole archive hash matches the source intake.
Each scan member hash, NIfTI shape, affine, label count, and affine-derived voxel volume match intake.
